review: 701.53a-1: typo 'A Incubator token' in the base expected text; corrected.

scenarios.title: Incubate N creates an Incubator token with N +1/+1 counters

setup.notes: The Incubator token is a colorless Incubator artifact with '{2}: Transform this token.' Library lists are top first; cards below the listed ones are irrelevant Forests.

decisions: A casts Eyes of Gitaxias, tapping three Islands.
B passes; Eyes of Gitaxias resolves: A incubates 3, then draws a card.

variants.label: resolves
variants.expected: An Incubator token enters the battlefield under A's control with three +1/+1 counters; it is a colorless noncreature artifact. A draws Forest.

variants.label: countered
variants.delta: B casts Counterspell in response, tapping two Islands.
variants.expected: Eyes of Gitaxias is countered and moves to A's graveyard. No Incubator token is created and A draws no card; Forest stays on top of A's library.

variants.label: transformed
variants.delta: After Eyes of Gitaxias resolves, A pays {2} (the two remaining Islands) to transform the Incubator token.
variants.expected: The token transforms into a Phyrexian Token, a 0/0 colorless Phyrexian artifact creature, keeping its three +1/+1 counters and so a 3/3. A draws Forest.
